summary: Iteration-11 testing complete. Backend 10/10 pytest green in 16.8s (demo-login + lowercase seeded types, Will AI-draft happy/auth/no-props-400, Listings generate+AI+no-ai+404+auth, GET /listings). Frontend Playwright 100% green: demo login -> /app without error toast; /app/will 'AI-draft a distribution' opens modal (family + style + go); 'Draft with AI' populates 6 beneficiaries + reasoning card; /app/properties shows list-for-rent button on owned property; listing modal -> Generate produces title+body+AI description+7 portal deep-links (99acres, MagicBricks, Housing.com, NoBroker, OLX, Quikr Homes, WhatsApp share) all https; copy button present; Calculators 14-tab regression OK.

ui_bugs.issue: AI description block lacks data-testid (e.g. 'listing-ai-desc' and 'listing-title'). Renders visually but not queryable for automated verification.

issues: Product tour modal re-appears on /app even when localStorage.estima_tour_seen is set on /login before navigation. The tour is keyed differently or only honored when set post-auth. Automation workaround: click 'Skip tour'. User impact: not a regression for this iteration.

action_items: Add data-testid='listing-ai-desc' to the AI description <div> in Properties.jsx ListingModal (~line 713) and data-testid='listing-title' + 'listing-body' on title/pre elements to improve testability.
(Optional) Ensure tour dismissal keys are respected when set on /login so demo flow doesn't surface tour modal on /app navigation.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 4232 lines (+241 from it-10) — the new AIWillRequest, _extract_json, /will/ai-draft, /listings/generate, /listings endpoints should be split into /routers/ai.py + /routers/listings.py (guideline <700/file).
Properties.jsx is 794 lines and now hosts both the main page and ListingModal — extract ListingModal into src/components/ListingModal.jsx for maintainability.
_extract_json uses regex and json.loads; if Claude returns valid JSON inside multiple code fences or with JS-style comments the parse will fail and raise 502. Consider json5 or a more lenient parser.

/listings/generate saves listing doc BEFORE returning; if AI call succeeded but DB insert fails the user sees a 500 while AI credits were spent. Wrap save in try/except and still return the listing body.

Portal URLs hardcoded; they don't actually pre-fill 99acres/MagicBricks/Housing/NoBroker/Quikr fields (only OLX + WhatsApp carry the query). Docstring already admits this — consider a UI tooltip: 'Paste the copied text after portal page loads.'
No rate-limit on /will/ai-draft or /listings/generate — each call burns LLM credits. Add per-user throttle (e.g. 10/hour).

/will/ai-draft trusts AI JSON shape beyond property_id filtering — no validation that beneficiary_index in splits is within bounds of beneficiaries[], could cause frontend index-out-of-range rendering.
ai_description in listing response can be None on AI failure without surfacing the error to the user; consider returning a soft warning field so UI can show 'AI description temporarily unavailable'.
test_credentials: admin@estima.com / Admin@123 (admin). Demo: POST /api/auth/demo-login (no body). A fresh TEST_it11_<uuid>@estima.com user was registered with Pass@1234 for the no-properties-400 test.
seed_data_creation: Demo user (demo@estima.com) + 4 pre-seeded properties reused; 1 ephemeral TEST_it11_* user registered; multiple listing docs created under demo_user (verified via GET /api/listings returning >=1 item).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 11 backend has 2 new endpoints — /api/will/ai-draft (AIWillRequest: family_context/distribution_style/custom_note) and /api/listings/generate (RentalListingRequest) + /api/listings. AI calls use Claude Sonnet 4.5 via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY and complete in 3-8s. Server-side normalizes each property's splits to ~100 after AI response; expect sum in [98,102]. Demo login still returns UserOut without is_demo field (carry-over from it-10) but is_pro=true + plan='pro'. Demo seeded properties now correctly have lowercase type ('flat'/'villa'). Only 1 demo property has status 'rented' (Indiranagar Flat) so list-for-rent button renders on exactly 1 card in UI. Portal links return all 7 portals; only OLX + WhatsApp pre-fill the search/share text via URL — others just link to 'post property' landing. Tour modal still intrudes on /app after demo login; use page.evaluate localStorage.setItem before clicking demo + explicit 'Skip tour' fallback in Playwright.

coverage: GET /api/properties (demo) -> >=4 props, all with lowercase type in {flat,villa,plot,commercial,other}
POST /api/will/ai-draft demo+family_context -> {ok:true, beneficiaries>=1, allocations only reference demo property IDs, splits sum in [98,102]}
POST /api/listings/generate use_ai=false -> ai_description null, title+body+7 https links
GET /api/listings (demo) -> array with id+title+body, no _id leak

verified_flows: 'Draft with AI' populates 6 beneficiaries + reasoning card ('Equal distribution across wife and 2 children...')
/app/properties data-testid='list-for-rent-{id}' present on owned/rented card (1 found for Indiranagar Flat)
listing modal -> Generate -> data-testid='listing-result' renders; 7 portal hrefs all https (99acres/MagicBricks/Housing.com/NoBroker/OLX/Quikr Homes/WhatsApp share)
/app/calculators regression — 14 tabs visible + 'The brutal math.' heading + Why-buy form rendered
not_fully_exercised: Actual click-through of portal deep-links (by design — they go to external sites)
Clipboard write of listing-copy (browser permission prompts in Playwright headless; copyText function logged 'copied' toast path not asserted)
AI description UI rendering — backend confirmed present; frontend lacks data-testid so couldn't assert innerText > 0 in the list-for-rent Generate flow

rca of the issue: N/A — no failures. Minor data-testid gap on ListingModal AI description block prevented full automated text assertion, but backend test_generate_with_ai confirms AI returns >30-char description and network payload flows to the component.
